rule.confirm: on 40 paired targets in the dress rehearsal (10/29) before anything moves
rule.definitions: gated catches are counted per target: a target counts once when any of its findings whose final status is blocker (it passed SK1's gates and the skeptic) has a repro that passes on gold when replayed at scoring, and the per-finding count is reported beside it; an invalid repro is a blocker finding whose repro does not pass on gold; the invalid-repro rate is per replayed finding, invalid repros over the blocker findings whose replay was scored, and with none scored there is no rate, so the rule is not met; a replay the sandbox could not answer twice is unscored, and while any is the rule is not judged; the founder alone may drop an unscored replay by its finding id, with a reason (score --replay-drop), which counts that finding on neither side and lists it with the reason in score.json
